brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net generative (in the Eno sense) taqsim. Use overlapping drones (semi-random ADSR but clamped so they're floaty and it works; length >= 20sec per)
- choice of maqam
- random choice of dumbek backing
- ability to clip the last N seconds (if feasible; not a requirement)
note: built taqsim: overlapping drone voices in a maqam of your choosing, clamped ADSR so nothing pops in sharp, a randomly-picked dumbek backing each run, and a clip-the-last-N-seconds button to grab a .wav of whatever just played.
